name: Content Publicity
author: sitetrail

sections.description:
The “Content Publicity” plugin by Sitetrail makes your valuable content more portable and shareable. It adds a simple, user-friendly “Share / Embed” button to your posts and pages (and custom post types you select), styled by default with an authoritative black & white theme.

When clicked, a clean modal appears offering:
* Social Sharing: Quick links to share the content on popular platforms like X (Twitter), Facebook, LinkedIn, and via Email, using WordPress Dashicons for a consistent look.
* Embed Code Generator: A ready-to-copy HTML embed code that allows other websites to feature your article. The embed code includes the post title (linked back to your original article), an optional featured image, an optional excerpt, and mandatory attribution to your site.

This helps increase your content’s visibility, encourages organic backlinks when others embed your articles, and ensures your site always gets the credit.

Key Features:
* Authoritative black & white default button style for high visibility.
* Customizable “Share / Embed” button text and display style (icon, text, or both).
* Select which post types the button appears on.
* Exclude specific posts/pages by ID.
* Enable/disable specific social sharing networks (X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Email).
* Uses WordPress Dashicons for social media icons in the modal for native WP feel.
* Control content included in the embed code (featured image, excerpt length).
* “Copy to Clipboard” functionality for easy embed code grabbing.
* Optional, toggleable credit link in the modal (off by default, links to this plugin’s WordPress.org page).
* Lightweight and designed for ease of use.
* Shortcode [content_publicity_button] for manual placement.

This plugin is brought to you by Sitetrail. For users looking to massively amplify their news and press release distribution to over 100+ authoritative news sites and Google News, check out the Sitetrail Newspass information within the plugin’s settings page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the content-publicity folder (containing content-publicity.php, readme.txt, LICENSE.txt, an assets folder with css/content-publicity-main.css and js/content-publicity-main.js inside, and an empty languages folder) as a ZIP file via the ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ > ‘Upload Plugin’ screen in your WordPress admin.
  2. Alternatively, unzip the package and upload the content-publicity folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your server.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to the “Content Publicity” menu in your WordPress admin dashboard to configure the settings.
    • Enable the button globally and select which post types it should appear on.
    • Customize the appearance, social networks, and embed code options to your liking.
  5. Optionally, use the shortcode [content_publicity_button] to place the share/embed button manually in your content or theme files.
sections.faq:
Where do I configure the plugin?

Once activated, you’ll find a “Content Publicity” menu item in your WordPress admin dashboard. All settings are located there.

What style is the share button?

The default button style is an authoritative black button with white text and icon, designed for high visibility. You can choose to display it as icon only, text only, or icon with text via the plugin settings.

Can I choose which social media sites appear?

Yes, in the plugin’s settings under “Social Sharing Settings,” you can enable or disable X (Twitter), Facebook, LinkedIn, and Email sharing options. Icons are provided by WordPress Dashicons.

How does the embed code work?

The plugin generates a simple HTML blockquote that includes a link back to your original article, the title, and optionally the featured image and an excerpt. This makes it easy for others to cite your content properly.

Is the credit link in the modal mandatory?

No. The “Shared via Content Publicity” credit in the sharing modal is optional and disabled by default. If you choose to enable it, it links to this plugin’s page on WordPress.org.

Does this plugin help with SEO?

By making your content easier to share and embed (with backlinks to your original article), it can contribute to increased visibility and organic backlink generation, which are beneficial for SEO. For proactive, large-scale news distribution and backlink building, we offer Sitetrail Newspass (details in plugin settings).
sections.changelog:
1.0.4 – 2025-05-16

  • Refactored frontend asset loading to use wp_add_inline_style and wp_add_inline_script for WordPress.org best practices.
  • Reviewed and enhanced escaping of variables for output.
  • Fixed automated WordPress.org plugin checker errors: Changed i18n text domain from constant to string literal in translation functions (from previous 1.0.4 iteration).
  • Updated “Tested up to” version to 6.8 in plugin header and readme.txt (from previous 1.0.4 iteration).
  • Adjusted “Domain Path” in plugin header to /languages/ (from previous 1.0.4 iteration).
  • Internal code refactoring for WordPress coding standards and best practices (constant and hook prefixing, class naming, ABSPATH check, removal of redundant textdomain loading – from previous 1.0.4 iteration). No functional changes.

1.0.3 – 2025-05-07

  • Updated default button style to an authoritative black & white theme.
  • Minor CSS adjustments for new default button style.

1.0.2 – 2025-05-07

  • Switched social media icons in modal to use WordPress Dashicons.
  • Ensured Dashicons stylesheet is enqueued on the front-end when needed.
  • Minor style adjustments for Dashicons in modal.

1.0.1 – 2025-05-07

  • Added Email as a social sharing option.
  • Minor style and script improvements for modal.
  • Updated default settings and sanitization for social networks.

1.0.0 – 2025-05-07

  • Initial release.
